_comment: One place for each source's licence status and privacy rules. Read by src/lib/sources.ts and scripts/aws-export.py. licence: 'open' = records carry their own open licence, 'per-record' = each record's licence decides (others skipped), 'unknown-pending' = shown on the map with credit, never in exports or bulk downloads, 'not-agreed' = never exported. Change 'unknown-pending' to 'open' (and set defaultLicence) once permission arrives.
